risk_summary: The sandbox denies network egress by default, blocks metadata and internal ranges, uses task-scoped credentials, and applies the same allowlist to helper channels.

helper_controls: URL fetcher canonicalizes redirects and DNS before policy checks
package installer uses the approved mirror only
policy decision logs include job id, tenant id, helper, destination, and correlation id

expected_assessment.review_note: The flow is a safe comparator because untrusted code and helper channels share default-deny egress, metadata blocking, tenant-scoped identity, and auditable policy decisions.
